title: Higher one-bit norms controlled by second norm
statement:
Fix a real exponent $q \ge 2$, and let $g : \{0,1\}^1 \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function of
arity one. Write $\norm{h}_p = \left(\E\,|h|^{p}\right)^{1/p}$ for the $L^p$ norm taken
with respect to the uniform measure, and let $T_\rho$ denote the noise operator. Then,
with noise parameter $\rho = 1/\sqrt{q-1}$,
\[
  \norm{T_{1/\sqrt{q-1}}\, g}_q \;\le\; \norm{g}_2 .
\] For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: g is a Boolean function of arity one (on the single-bit cube)
left norm is the L^q norm, right norm is the L^2 norm, both under the uniform measure
